question: To buy a car, Taniya borrowed ₹75,000 at 8% per annum simple interest for 27 months. How much interest will she pay?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total Interest Rate % = Rate × Time (in years)

Total Interest Rate % = 8% × (27/12) = 18%

Simple Interest = 18% of 75,000

Simple Interest = 18 × 750 = 13,500

**∴ Answer = ₹13,500**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Principal (P) = ₹75,000

Rate (R) = 8% per annum

Time (T) = 27 months

**Formula used:**

Simple Interest (SI) = (P × R × T) / 100

 Simple Interest Timeline 
• 
• 
• Month 0 Month 27 P = ₹75,000 R = 8% p.a. 
 Total Interest = ₹13,500 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Time (T) = 27 / 12 years

⇒ T = 9 / 4 = 2.25 years

⇒ SI = (75,000 × 8 × 2.25) / 100

⇒ SI = 750 × 8 × 2.25

⇒ SI = 750 × 18

⇒ SI = 13,500

**∴ The correct answer is (1).**
